identificationModule.briefTitle: The Clinical Trial of TQB2102 for Injection Against Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 Negative Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of TQB2102 for Injection in Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2) Negative Recurrent/Metastatic Breast Cancer

leadSponsor.name: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of TQB2102 for injection in HER2 negative recurrent/metastatic breast cancer.

armGroups.label: TQB2102 for injection
armGroups.description: 7.5mg/kg TQB2102, intravenous infusion, administered every 3 weeks, 21 days as a treatment cycle.

interventions.name: TQB2102 for injection
interventions.description: TQB2102 for injection is a HER2 dual-antibody-drug conjugate (ADC).

primaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of subjects achieving complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) as assessed by the investigator based on the RECIST 1.1.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 months after study start.

secondaryOutcomes.description: From randomization to the time of disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 36 months after study start

secondaryOutcomes.description: For subjects whose best response is CR or PR , it is defined as from the date when tumor response is first recorded to the date when disease progression is first recorded or the date of death from any cause, whichever occurs first.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 months after study start

secondaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of subjects with CR, PR, or stable disease(SD) at 6 weeks or more as determined by RECIST 1.1.
